name: obsidian-vault-reader
description: Connect a user-selected Obsidian vault to Codex for searching, reading and editing notes.

interface.shortDescription: 自选知识库，在 Codex 中搜索、阅读与修改笔记。
interface.longDescription: Connect your own local Obsidian vault. Search Markdown notes, read sources, create and edit notes, move or delete with local backups. Each user chooses their vault and read-only or read-write access. Built on trsdn/obsidian-mcp.
defaultPrompt: 连接我的 Obsidian 知识库，允许查询和修改
搜索知识库并引用相关笔记
根据我的要求更新一篇笔记
